setMarksHelp.message: Colours words by their status in your word list. Each status has its own colour and any mix of highlight, underline and text colour (none: left plain). Video subtitles and screen text (OCR) use the page text settings unless you give them their own.

syncIntro.message: Keeps your words, library and reading places the same on all your devices: this browser extension, the web app and the phone app. Everything is encrypted on your device with your sync code before it is sent, so the server stores only data it cannot read. Anyone with the code can join, so keep it to yourself.

syncHaveCode.message: Already syncing on another device? Enter its code here:
